book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第三册
source: 外研社新标准选择性必修第三册 Unit 6 词表(p62-71 真词);课标词优先,跳过过于生僻的专有名词;IPA 英音照课本回填;例句原创、围绕初雪/冬天/童年/自然主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: During the war Priestley presented a weekly radio programme about daily life.
words.example_cn: 战时,普里斯特利主持一档每周一次的广播节目,谈论日常生活。

words.example_en: Priestley is best remembered for his famous play An Inspector Calls.
words.example_cn: 普里斯特利最为人铭记的是他著名的剧作《探长来访》。

words.meaning_cn: 坚称;坚决认为;坚持要求
words.example_en: I must insist that last night's first fall of snow was a real event.
words.example_cn: 我必须坚持说,昨夜的初雪是一件大事。

words.example_en: The very secrecy and quietness of the falling snow made it feel more magical.
words.example_cn: 正是落雪的隐秘与安静,让它显得更加神奇。

words.example_en: The strange morning light made the familiar business of washing and shaving feel new.
words.example_cn: 奇异的晨光,让洗漱和刮胡子这些熟悉的事都变得新鲜。

words.example_en: The morning sun began to flush the white snow with delicate pink.
words.example_cn: 晨曦开始把白雪染上淡淡的粉色。

words.example_en: The little plum tree outside stood quietly in the full winter sunlight.
words.example_cn: 外面那棵小李树静静地立在冬日的阳光里。

words.example_en: Soft snow lay faintly along the thin branches of the small tree.
words.example_cn: 薄雪隐约地铺在小树细细的枝条上。

words.example_en: An hour later everything outside was a cold sparkle of white and blue.
words.example_cn: 一个小时后,外面的一切都成了白与蓝的清冷闪光。

words.example_en: There was something curiously disturbing about the whole white prospect.
words.example_cn: 整片白色的景象中有一种奇怪而令人不安的东西。

words.example_en: By noon the bright glare of the snow had completely gone.
words.example_cn: 到了中午,雪地刺眼的强光已经完全消失。

words.example_en: The snow was now falling in great soft flakes past the window.
words.example_cn: 此刻雪正以大片柔软的雪花掠过窗前落下。

words.example_en: The heavy snow made all the trees bend low towards the ground.
words.example_cn: 厚厚的积雪把所有的树都压得低低地弯向地面。

words.example_en: The weathercock of the village church could still be seen through the grey air.
words.example_cn: 透过灰蒙蒙的空气,仍能看见村庄教堂上的风标。

words.example_en: A childhood rhyme about snow kept running through his head.
words.example_cn: 一首关于雪的童年童谣一直在他脑海里回响。

words.example_en: The first snow brought back the innocent happiness of his childhood.
words.example_cn: 初雪带回了他童年那份天真无邪的快乐。

words.example_en: Vivid images can enhance a writer's description of the first snow.
words.example_cn: 生动的意象能增强作家对初雪的描写。

words.example_en: In August the golden wheat waves gently in every passing wind.
words.example_cn: 八月里,金黄的小麦在每一阵微风中轻轻起伏。

words.example_en: A gentle wind swept softly across the snowy winter field.
words.example_cn: 一阵轻柔的风轻轻拂过雪白的冬日田野。

words.example_en: The cold wind would sweep across the open field all afternoon.
words.example_cn: 整个下午,寒风会掠过开阔的田野。

words.example_en: Silent Spring led many countries to ban the harmful chemical DDT.
words.example_cn: 《寂静的春天》促使许多国家禁用有害的化学品 DDT。

words.example_en: On spring mornings the dawn chorus of birds once filled the quiet woods.
words.example_cn: 春天的清晨,鸟儿的黎明合唱曾经回荡在寂静的树林里。

words.example_en: The book gives dozens of clear examples of harm done to nature.
words.example_cn: 这本书给出了几十个对自然造成伤害的清晰例子。

words.example_en: Her long list of sources showed how thorough a scientist she was.
words.example_cn: 她长长的资料来源清单显示出她是一位多么缜密的科学家。

words.example_en: Her research was careful and precise, like that of a true scientist.
words.example_cn: 她的研究细致而精确,如同一位真正的科学家。

words.example_en: Silent Spring marked the launch of the green movement in the West.
words.example_cn: 《寂静的春天》标志着西方绿色运动的开端。

words.example_en: Critics tried to damage Carson's reputation, but she stood firm.
words.example_cn: 批评者试图损害卡森的名誉,但她坚定不移。

words.example_en: The beauty and elegance of her writing reached millions of readers.
words.example_cn: 她文字的优美与简洁打动了数百万读者。

words.meaning_cn: 充满激情的;有强烈信念的
words.example_en: Readers can still feel the passionate message of her famous warning.
words.example_cn: 读者至今仍能感受到她那著名警告中充满激情的讯息。

words.example_en: In the old rhyme the bright star shines like a diamond in the sky.
words.example_cn: 在那首古老的童谣里,明亮的星星像钻石一样在天空闪烁。

words.example_en: Spring flowers bloom long after the last winter snow has melted.
words.example_cn: 冬天最后一场雪融化很久之后,春花才会盛开。

words.example_en: The charms of August come from its contrast with the cold winter.
words.example_cn: 八月的魅力来自它与寒冬的对比。

words.example_en: When the bleak winds of winter blow, we long for warm, sunny days.
words.example_cn: 当阴冷的冬风吹起,我们便渴望温暖的晴日。

words.example_en: By summer the memory of snow and ice had faded from our minds.
words.example_cn: 到了夏天,雪与冰的记忆已从我们脑海中淡去。

words.example_en: In late summer the orchard is full of trees heavy with ripe fruit.
words.example_cn: 夏末的果园里,树木挂满了沉甸甸的成熟果实。

words.example_en: The branches bent low beneath thick clusters of rich, ripe fruit.
words.example_cn: 枝条被一串串丰美成熟的果实压得低垂。

words.example_en: The farmers pile the golden wheat into neat and graceful sheaves.
words.example_cn: 农民们把金色的麦子堆成整齐而优美的麦束。

words.example_en: The setting sun would tinge the snowy landscape with soft gold.
words.example_cn: 落日会把雪景微微染上柔和的金色。

words.example_en: A slow wagon crossed the field, making almost no sound at all.
words.example_cn: 一辆缓慢的运货车穿过田野,几乎没有发出任何声响。

words.example_en: Farmers reap the ripe wheat from the well-cut fields in August.
words.example_cn: 八月里,农民们从收割整齐的田地里收割成熟的小麦。

words.example_en: Many people felt puzzled and worried when the birds suddenly disappeared.
words.example_cn: 当鸟儿突然消失时,许多人感到困惑而忧虑。

words.example_en: The feeding stations in the quiet backyards stood empty and still.
words.example_cn: 安静后院里的喂食台空荡荡的,一动不动。

words.example_en: The few birds left would tremble violently and could not fly.
words.example_cn: 剩下的少数几只鸟剧烈地颤抖,无法飞起。

words.example_en: Carson called her opening chapter 'A Fable for Tomorrow'.
words.example_cn: 卡森把她的开篇一章称为《明日寓言》。

words.example_en: She hoped to alert the public to the damage being done to nature.
words.example_cn: 她希望提醒公众注意正在对自然造成的破坏。

words.example_en: Some critics said Carson was only a marine biologist, not a chemist.
words.example_cn: 一些批评者说卡森只是个海洋生物学家,而非化学家。

words.example_en: In the old rhyme the falling snow is like white feathers sent from far away.
words.example_cn: 在那首古老的童谣里,落雪如同从远方寄来的白色羽毛。

words.example_en: A white goose in the yard looked almost invisible against the fresh snow.
words.example_cn: 院子里一只白鹅,衬着新雪几乎看不见。
